title: Mollification by an even kernel of radius σ < δ does not increase the variation on Q_δ: ∫_{Q_δ}‖D(ρ⋆1_{Q₁}u)‖ ≤ V
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure, Q₁ := {y : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i}, Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, and div g := trace Dg. Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on Q₁ and V ∈ ℝ with ∫_{Q₁} u · div g ≤ V for every C^∞ map g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and |g| ≤ 1. Let δ, σ ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ < δ, and let ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C^∞ and even (ρ(−z) = ρ(z) for all z), with ρ ≥ 0, ∫ρ = 1 and support ρ ⊆ B_σ(0). Then f := ρ ⋆ (1_{Q₁}u), f(x) = ∫ ρ(t) (1_{Q₁}u)(x − t) dt (Mathlib's convolution with lsmul ℝ ℝ and volume), satisfies ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Df(x)‖ dx ≤ V (operator norm of fderiv, Bochner integral).
